articles.summary: WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), the parent company of WSFS Bank, expects to report its third quarter earnings at the end of business on Thursday, October 22, 2026. Management will conduct a conference call to review this information at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) on Friday, October 23, 2026. Interested parties can register in advance here or access the conference call live at investors.wsfsbank.com . Earnings release and supplemental materials will be available prior to the start of the event via the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website and participants are advised to log on at least 15 minutes prior to the broadcast. For those who cannot access the live conference call, a replay will be accessible shortly after the event concludes through the links above. articles.summary: Charles Mosher Named Executive Vice President, Chief Audit Executive; Michael Thompson Appointed Senior Vice President, Interim Chief Accounting Officer; Lisa Washington Promoted to Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), today announced the appointment of Charles “Chuck” Mosher as Executive Vice President, Chief Audit Executive, and the promotion of Lisa Washington, to Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary, effective today. Mosher and Washington are both experienced members of the WSFS senior leadership team and will continue to lead two critical areas of the company’s governance and risk management framework. Mosher is a Certified Public Accountant and joined WSFS over 25 years ago and has served in a variety of leadership positions in the Finance and Accounting groups.
